descriptor: Seed-Integrated Behavioral Estimands, Seed-Selection Bias, Monte-Carlo Measurement Convergence, Representation×Randomization Marginalization & Reproducible Hosted-Inference Measurement

technical_recovery.scope: Exactly 14 P50 technical failures were replayed; no successful scientific call was rerun.

interpretation: Gemini's explicit-seed interface supports a reproducible representation-indexed randomization-marginal surface, strong Monte-Carlo convergence, and measurable single-seed selection bias. Groq-hosted GPT-OSS benefits strongly from averaging and exhibits single-draw bias, but independent-half surface reproducibility did not survive the precommitted test; therefore no interface-level marginal estimand is constituted there at the P50 budget.
authority: P50 establishes an explicit-seed randomization-marginal measurement object for the tested Gemini hosted interface only. It does not establish a universal hosted-inference estimand, provider mechanism, neural state, or behavioral-SVEC.
